name: agentex-copilot
description: Agentic QA for GitHub Copilot, ported from AgenTeX. Use `copilot plugin marketplace add mabdel130/agentex-copilot`, then `copilot plugin install agentex-copilot@agentex-copilot` if you have the Copilot CLI; otherwise run `npx github:mabdel130/agentex-copilot` inside the project you want to test as a fallback.
